{{Quote|This is Lake Retreat of the Naberrie family, one of the most honored families in Naboo history. Queen Padmé Amidala was a Naberrie, along with several former Senators and many high officials.|Lareen Dantara, to an unnamed [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Lareen Dantara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She worked at the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]], a private retreat in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of Naboo that belonged to the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family]].

Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] visitor brought his pet [[krahbu]] to the retreat. It got loose and started killing local wildlife and livestock. A visiting adventurer agreed to hunt the krahbu down and kill it for a small sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Soon after, Dantara had another job for the adventurer. The krahbu had infected a local [[Mott/Legends|mott]] with a Corellian virus. The disease drove the creature insane and it had to be put down before the epidemic could spread. As a reward for the adventurer's services, Dantara gave the adventurer access to the retreat to take a look around.

==Behind the scenes==
Lareen Dantara was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. She could be found at the Lake Retreat on Naboo. Dantara offered two small quests to players, wherein the player had to kill two creatures and received a small sum of credits as a reward.
